name: Diagnose HDD client
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca 'set -u; cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken; echo compose-settings:; grep -nE "image:|container_name:|ports:|volumes:|environment:|UA_DATA_DIR|BROWSE_ROOTS|webui" docker-compose.local.yml; echo mounted-config:; grep -nE '"(default_trackers|multiScreens|charLimit|processLimit|qbit_|deluge_|radarr_|sonarr_)' docker-data/data/config.py | head -100; echo recent-logs:; podman logs --tail 40 upload-assistant-wastaken 2>&1; echo mounts:; podman inspect upload-assistant-wastaken --format "{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Source " -> " .Destination}}{{end}}"'
description: Diagnose Destiny’s migrated HDD client configuration, mounts, and recent container errors without exposing credentials.
